cv.name: Sanne Dijkstra
cv.headline: Senior Compliance Officer & Lawyer | Trade Sanctions, Export Control, AML
cv.summary: Dutch lawyer turned compliance officer with twelve years in the port and shipping sector. I combine trade sanctions and export control compliance with hands-on contract work, and can move between the compliance function and an in-house legal role.

experience.title: Senior Compliance Officer – Trade & Sanctions
bullets: Built the sanctions screening process for vessels, cargo owners and counterparties across 3,000 port calls a year
Advise the board on EU and US sanctions exposure and on dual-use goods under Regulation (EU) 2021/821
Ran the company-wide compliance training; completion rose from 64% to 97%
First point of contact for Customs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on licence questions

experience.title: Legal Counsel
bullets: Drafted and negotiated agency, stevedoring and logistics contracts under Dutch and English law
Handled cargo claims and supported litigation with external counsel
Set up the KYC process for new principals

experience.title: Advocaat-stagiaire
bullets: Commercial litigation and transport law cases for SME clients

certifications: ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance, 2022
